[NSTG.2.4.1] The engine has already removed the key from its own
cache; the cb persists the removal to the backing store. Idempotent:
deleting a missing key returns `DS_OK`, not `DS_ERR_STORAGE_NOT_FOUND`.
A NULL `delete_cb` is a volatile delete (engine only), not an error; a
wired cb's failure is reported, not rolled back ([NSTG.2.3.3]).
